cues.text: When pants or a skirt are too loose at the waist, we take them in. Here is how to pin it.
The customer stands relaxed, wearing the pants. Do not ask them to suck in.
Stand behind them. Pinch the extra fabric at the center back seam, until it fits.
Pin up and down along the pinch, from the waistband down. Most waists are taken in at the back.
Two fingers should still fit inside the waistband. Too tight is worse than a little loose.
Ask the customer to sit down carefully. It should still feel okay when sitting.
Let them check in the mirror.
Measure the pinch and write it on the ticket, like: take in waist one inch total, back seam.
If it needs more than about two inches, or there are back pockets and belt loops in the way, write it down and let the tailor decide.
